title: Who controls integration delivery and promotion to main?
question: Who controls integration delivery and promotion to main?
answer:
V3-6: Verified work reaches public integration; one integration to main PR is left open for Kayden's approval and "is never merged by the implementation agent".
V3-24C: Verified public integration, followed by one open integration-to-main PR for Kayden to approve.
U313-0: No. main is not updated until the v3.1.3 build is done.
BPR-8F1: Asking whether a candidate is ready for main authorizes an independent release review and a verdict only, not merge or publication. Kayden keeps approval and merge authority for integration to main. An agent may create the release PR only when explicitly asked, and Kayden still approves and merges it.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: V3-6, V3-24C, U313-0, BPR-8F1 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
